digest.title: 3-month fluoride recall cuts caries recurrence 38% better than 6-month
digest.summary: 2,100-patient trial: high-risk adult patients on a 3-month fluoride varnish recall showed 38% lower caries recurrence than those on the standard 6-month recall.
